title: Phase 6 GUI Alpha
objective: Build a macOS-first Tauri GUI alpha for Anahtar on top of anahtar-app without duplicating KDBX logic.
evidence: Initial scaffold created; critical documents still require Plannotator gate approval.

GUI backend command tests passed: generated vault inspect/list/search/show works without revealing password; wrong password returns safe error without echoing password.
